'''Alun Millward Davies''' (born 2 August 1955) is a [[Welsh people|Welsh]] biologist, Distinguished Research Professor, School of Biosciences, [[Cardiff University]], since 2004.<ref>'DAVIES, Prof. Alun Millward’, Who's Who 2012, A & C Black, 2012; online edn, Oxford University Press, Dec 2011; online edn, Nov 2011 [http://www.ukwhoswho.com/view/article/oupww/whoswho/U254341, accessed 14 Jan 2012]</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.cf.ac.uk/biosi/contactsandpeople/stafflist/a-d/davies-alun-prof-overview_new.html|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20090130040011/http://www.cf.ac.uk/biosi/contactsandpeople/stafflist/a-d/davies-alun-prof-overview_new.html|archivedate=2009-01-30|title= Prof Alun Davies - MB ChB, PhD, FRSE|website=School of Biosciences, Cardiff University}}</ref>

He was elected a Fellow of the [[Academy of Medical Sciences (United Kingdom)|Academy of Medical Sciences]] in 2010<ref>{{Cite web |title=Professor Alun Davies FRS FRSE FLSW FMedsci |url=https://acmedsci.ac.uk/fellows/fellows-directory/ordinary-fellows/fellow/Alun%20Millward-Davies-0033z00002qIJGrAAO |access-date=2026-06-10 |website=Academy of Medical Sciences}}</ref> and of the [[Learned Society of Wales]] in 2011.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Alun Davies |url=https://www.learnedsociety.wales/fellow/alun-davies/ |access-date=2026-06-10 |website=The Learned Society of Wales |language=en-US}}</ref>
